title: TUR speech catalogue entry
description: One speech recognition model, voice activity detector, voice or engine (a program downloaded on first use: Piper) that TUR offers to run on the person's own computer for P@x's voice (docs/architecture/pax-voice.md). Written in TOML, one file per entry, in services/tur-ai-local/speech/<id>.toml; this schema describes the document the TOML parses to. The loader in services/tur-ai-local (src/speech.rs) is authoritative and also enforces: the file is named <id>.toml; every file URL names the pinned revision (40 hexadecimal digits) and ends with the file's name, except an engine's, which is under https://files.pythonhosted.org/ with source_url and source_sha256; a recognition model is used by whisper.cpp or by its parakeet-cli; a recognition model is one .bin file with encode_ms_8_threads; a voice detector is one .bin file; an engine is one .whl file; a voice is one .onnx file and its .onnx.json, speaks one language, has a sample_rate and [voice]; default_for names languages the voice speaks, and no language has two default voices; memory_bytes is at least the files; ids and file names are unique.

id.description: Stable identifier: lower-case letters, digits, '.' and '-'.

name.description: The name shown to a person.

revision.description: The commit the URLs are pinned to (40 lower-case hexadecimal digits); for an engine from the Python Package Index, its release, the files being pinned by their SHA-256.

parameters.description: Its size as the publisher states it.

items.description: A two-letter BCP 47 primary language tag, or mul for a multilingual model.

default_for.description: The languages it is the default voice for.

items.description: A two-letter BCP 47 primary language tag, or mul for a multilingual model.

memory_bytes.description: The memory it needs; an estimate whose basis is speed_basis.

encode_ms_8_threads.description: A recognition model's encode time for one 30-second window with 8 threads, in milliseconds: the reference of the speed rule. An estimate.

speed_basis.description: Where the speed and memory figures come from.

wer_it_fleurs.description: Word error rate on Italian FLEURS, in percent, where published.

note.description: What it is good for, in plain words.

credit.description: The attribution its licence asks for, shown with it; exactly none when there is none.

source_url.description: An engine's source archive, a .tar.gz under https://files.pythonhosted.org/, offered with the program as the GPL asks. Only an engine has one, and it must.

source_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the source archive.

name.description: The publisher's file name, also the stored name.

url.description: The publisher's download URL, pinned to the revision.

size_bytes.description: The exact size; a file of another size is refused.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the whole file; a file with another digest is refused.

id.description: SPDX expression, or LicenseRef- for a licence SPDX does not list.

summary.description: What the licence lets a person do, in plain sentences.

restrictions.description: Exactly none, or the use restrictions in plain sentences, followed through every base a voice was trained from.

evidence.description: What was read to establish the licence.
